title: Third headset test: small explosion when enemies die; Needle Drones drift around their hover point
acceptance: A killed enemy disappears in a short flash with debris (bosses keep their own collapse); nothing is allocated beyond the burst, which removes itself
Needle Drones, once at their hover point, keep drifting inside a zone around it (mostly sideways and up/down relative to the rig), slow enough to track; slower during the warning
All ETM tests pass; installed on the Quest 3
description: Owner feedback 2026-11-18: 'when they die, let them [go] in a small explosion'; drones should 'swarm around... fly around, move around gradually within that axis, so that you aim them and you shoot' instead of standing in one place.
